name: Vile Familiars
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Vile Familiars pour from a nearby cavern. Zureetha Fargaze found a hidden Burning Blade coven while watching over the trials. Now recruits hunt the familiars spreading across Durotar's red earth.

sections.title: A Shadow in the Valley
sections.body: Young orcs and Darkspear trolls face tests of strength, discipline, and loyalty to Thrall's Horde in the Valley of Trials. They were meant to face scorpids and boars, not demonic corruption. Yet a cave to the northeast shelters Burning Blade agents. They have formed a secret coven beneath the valley overseers' watch.

sections.title: Culling the Imps
sections.body: Zureetha Fargaze guides newcomers near the Den. She spotted the taint before it could overrun the canyon. Now Vile Familiars pour from the cave mouth and hurl fire at anyone who wanders too close. Before the Horde can root out the hidden masters, young recruits are sent to cut down these lesser servants and keep the valley secure.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Vile Familiars?
aliases: where to pick up vile familiars
faq.answer: Zureetha Fargaze gives the task. She waits just outside the Den's entrance in the center of the Valley of Trials.
Vile Familiars are small, imp-like demons summoned and bound by Burning Blade cultists. These lesser minions and pets wield fire against intruders.

faq.q: Where is the Burning Blade Coven located?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade coven hides in a cave in the northeastern Valley of Trials. It lies past the roaming Mottled Boars and Scorpid Workers.

faq.q: Why is the Burning Blade in the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade is a covert cult bent on undermining Thrall's new Horde and spreading demonic corruption. From the Valley of Trials, its members can hide while threatening the Horde's newest fighters as the Horde establishes its sovereignty.

faq.q: What happens after completing Vile Familiars?
faq.answer: Once the familiars outside the cavern are thinned out, Zureetha Fargaze sends you into the cave. There, you face the cultist leader and recover a Burning Blade Medallion.

faq.q: Do I have to go deep into the cave to find the familiars?
faq.answer: No. Vile Familiars dwell inside the cavern, but many swarm around the entrance and across the canyon floor outside the cave mouth.

angles.text: As an orc, you meet fel taint in your sacred training grounds. It is a bitter reminder that the Shadow Council's legacy still festers despite Thrall's rejection of demonic slavery.
As a member of the Horde, you face the Burning Blade's attempt to corrupt Durotar from within. The young Horde must firmly establish its sovereignty.
As an orc or troll warlock, you face rogue shadowcasters who use demonic pacts for destruction. You bend fel energies toward the Horde's survival.
